spec_reference: spec/contract.md 6.11-0009, 6.3-0003, 6.3-0004: single op_identity lines. CireSnave ruled board 451 on 2026-11-16 (verbatim: "451: 1: A.  2: A.  3: A.  4: A."). The field list and the field order are those of spec/ops.md 6.19.3 (also conformance/corpus/op_facts.json, `opattrs`); enum names are those of 6.19.2.
rulings_pinned: (1) The {...} list spells EVERY field of the op's OpAttrs record, defaults included, in the 6.19.3 canonical order; an op with no record is bare. (2) key = the field name; enum = its 6.19.2 name; number = canonical decimal (no sign, no leading zero); dtype = its KISS-Classify token, `compute-dtype` for an accumulator at the compute dtype; flag = true|false; axis set or window vector = [0,1], no spaces. An axis set is the explicit ascending list, never rall/rlast. (3) A reader decides only what the line shows: a missing field is `op-identity-incomplete`; whether a line was reduced to the bare name is a producer rule (6.3-0004). (4) A role-tuple suffix [role:dtype, ...] is read for shape only; the closed role set is KISS-Grammar's.
